lesson.title: Writing a Complete Letter About a Festival
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: ਹੁਣ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਵਾਰੀ! (Now it's time to put it all together!) Today, write one complete, real formal letter.

Using Day 1's letter structure (ਪਿਆਰੇ greeting, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ subject, ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਸਤਿਕਾਰ ਸਹਿਤ closing) and this week's festival and food vocabulary, write a complete letter to a family member describing a festival you celebrated: what happened (ਜਸ਼ਨ, ਇਕੱਠਾ, ਨੱਚਣਾ, ਗਾਇਆ), and what you ate (ਦਾਲ, ਚੌਲ, ਸਬਜ਼ੀ, ਮਿਠਾਈ, ਸੁਆਦੀ). Aim for at least 5-6 sentences total, following the proper greeting-subject-closing structure.
ਸ਼ਾਬਾਸ਼! (Well done!) You just wrote a complete, real formal letter in Punjabi describing a festival and its food — genuine cultural composition.

objectives: Write a complete formal letter following the greeting-subject-closing structure
Correctly use this week's festival and food vocabulary within the letter
materialsNeeded: This week's earlier worksheets for vocabulary reference
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review the Day 1 letter structure and this week's vocabulary.
2. Help the child plan the letter's 3 parts before writing.
3. Have the child write the complete letter, checking structure and vocabulary use.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow a shorter letter (3-4 sentences) as long as the greeting-subject-closing structure is present
Ready for more: challenge them to add a question to the letter's recipient, inviting a response
All Gurmukhi words/phrases used in this lesson were validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: Answers will vary — check the letter includes a proper greeting, a clear subject describing the festival and food, correct use of at least 3-4 of this week's new vocabulary words, and the proper closing.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Synthesizes the course's 'letter writing' and 'cultural units — festivals, cuisine' descriptions into one complete, authentic piece of formal writing, the genuine culmination this week's vocabulary was built toward.

generationData.instructions: Write a complete formal letter to a family member describing a festival and its food, using proper greeting-subject-closing structure.
